summary: Frontend testing of Top Brands section redesign with scrollable carousel and 8 brand logos. All 5 requested features tested and working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Top Brands section redesigned with 8 brand logos, horizontal scrolling carousel with navigation arrows, brand filter functionality. Note: Brand filtering shows medicines but with 0 results because database lacks 'manufacturer' field - this is a known data limitation, not a UI bug.

top_brands_8_logos.details: All 8 brand logos displayed: Torrent, Aristo, WinOvulation, Sun Pharma, Dr. Reddy's, Mankind, Zydus, Fibovil. Using data-testid='brand-{id}' for each brand button.

horizontal_scrolling.details: Top Brands section is horizontally scrollable with smooth scroll behavior (scrollBy 250px). Container has overflow-x-auto and scrollbar styling.

scroll_navigation_arrows.details: Left (<) and right (>) scroll arrows visible at top-right of section title. Buttons have data-testid='brands-scroll-left' and 'brands-scroll-right'. Disabled state (opacity-40) when at scroll boundary.

brand_filter_on_click.details: Clicking brand logo triggers filter - section title changes to brand name (e.g., 'Torrent'). Uses isBrand flag to query by manufacturer parameter.

hover_effects.details: Brand buttons have hover effects: hover:shadow-lg, hover:border-orange-400, hover:scale-105, transition-all duration-200. Logo also scales on hover with group-hover:scale-105.

ui_design_review.section_title: 'Top brands for you' with bold text
ui_design_review.brand_cards: w-24 h-24 (md:w-28 md:h-28) rounded-2xl with white background and gray border
ui_design_review.scroll_buttons: w-8 h-8 rounded-full with gray border, ChevronLeft/ChevronRight icons
ui_design_review.spacing: gap-4 between brand cards, scrollbar-thin styling
